description: A hybrid (SSE or stdio) MCP server for the LG ThinQ Connect Smart Solutions API
name: io.github.StefH/mcpserver.ThinQConnect

package_arguments.name: --country
package_arguments.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used for ThinQ requests, for example US or GB. Default value is NL.

package_arguments.name: --pat
package_arguments.description: ThinQ Personal Access Token used for API requests.

package_arguments.name: --baseurl
package_arguments.description: Optional ThinQ API base URL override. When omitted, the server uses https://api-eic.lgthinq.com.

package_arguments.name: --stdio
package_arguments.description: Run this MCP server as stdio.

package_arguments.name: --sse
package_arguments.description: Run this MCP server as SSE.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_COUNTRY
environment_variables.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used for ThinQ requests, for example US or GB. Default value is NL.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_PAT
environment_variables.description: ThinQ Personal Access Token used for API requests.

environment_variables.name: THINQ_BASEURL
environment_variables.description: Optional ThinQ API base URL override. When omitted, the server uses https://api-eic.lgthinq.com.
